transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We're doing our routine pre-publication check-in for the catalog. I'd like to focus on 'Glass Harbor' — the current draft lists it at 94 minutes with premiere status still marked for confirmation. I need submissions and technical screening staff to report any status or master-file issues so I can make the final programming and delivery decision. Can someone from submissions confirm where things stand on the premiere status, and can technical screening confirm what master file we have?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I checked the national festival database yesterday and confirmed that 'Glass Harbor' already had a public screening at the Coastline Film Week in this country. I recorded the result in my local review notes, but the database export feeding your catalog review has not refreshed, which is why the premiere status still shows as 'for confirmation.'
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I completed ingest quality control this morning and confirmed that the filmmaker's approved festival cut is an 88-minute DCP, not the 94 minutes listed in the catalog draft. The QC report is waiting in the technical queue and has not yet been attached to the programming record.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Update the catalog draft to reflect 88 minutes runtime and premiere status as 'not a national premiere' based on the Coastline Film Week screening.
Assign 'Glass Harbor' to the panorama program, as it is not eligible for national competition due to not being a national premiere.
Use the approved 88-minute DCP festival cut as the screening master and attach the QC report to the programming record.
